# View geometry cases shared by Wind (Windows) and Wind for Mac. Read by tests/test_shared_fixtures.cpp
# (src/transform/transform.h, src/track/edge_pan.h, src/track/view_glide.h, src/input/keyboard_pan.h)
# and by mac/Tests/WindCoreChecks/SharedFixtures.swift (mac/Sources/WindCore/ViewMath.swift).
#
# One case per line: <function> <platform> <inputs...> =<expected> ...
#   platform: all (both run it), win (Windows only), mac (Mac only). A function or row that differs on
#   purpose is tagged per platform instead of forced to agree.
#   Expected values are the tokens that start with '='. Numbers match within 1e-6 (absolute); words
#   (none) match exactly. Coordinates are desktop px (Windows) or points (Mac), top-left origin; the
#   view is its centre and level and shows screen/level around it. Margins are whole percent.
# all and win rows come from the C++ code (Windows is the origin): after an intended change there,
#   set WIND_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1 && build.bat test
# rewrites them, then the Mac must match. mac rows are written by hand from the Swift code.
#
#   clamp  cx cy level W H                                   =cx =cy   (ComputeOffsetF + half a view / clampCenter)
#   edge   curX curY ptrX ptrY level W H margin bL bT bR bB  =cx =cy   (EdgePanCenter, no MPO wall / edgePanCenter)
#   track  l t r b curX curY level W H align margin          =cx =cy, or =none for a rejected rect
#   still  tX tY curX curY ptrX ptrY level W H margin lead   =tx =ty   (Mac only: stillViewTarget has no Windows twin)
#   keypan level W panSpeed                                  =desktop px per second (differs on purpose: see below)

# clamp: the centre stays half a view from every edge
clamp all 960 540 2 1920 1080 =960 =540
clamp all 10 1070 4 1920 1080 =240 =945
clamp all 500 500 1 1920 1080 =960 =540
clamp all 100 100 0.5 1920 1080 =960 =540
clamp all 0 0 2 1920 1080 =480 =270
clamp all 1920 1080 2 1920 1080 =1440 =810
clamp all 1919 5 8 1920 1080 =1800 =67.5
clamp all 3000 -500 3 1920 1080 =1600 =180
clamp all 2500 1200 30 2560 1440 =2500 =1200
clamp all 1 1 64 3840 2160 =30 =16.875
clamp all 3839 2159 64 3840 2160 =3810 =2143.125
clamp all 1234.5 678.25 7.3 3840 2160 =1234.5 =678.25
clamp all 1000 500 1.5 1366 768 =910.6666667 =500

# keypan: Windows' ZoomRateScale power curve vs the Mac's linear ease (0.5 at 1x up to 1 at 3x)
